claim: Replacing the external DR subtraction mass by mu_chi = z chi^(1/(1-epsilon)) permits an exactly scale-invariant renormalised functional order by order.
evidence: Tamarit arXiv:1309.0913; Herrero-Valea arXiv:2007.04335; explicit construction in v0.5 Sections 3.1-3.3
limitation: Renormalisation generates an infinite symmetry-compatible higher-dimensional operator tower.
next_test: Compute selected two-loop counterterms in the QCD-plus-chi sector and verify the Ward identity explicitly.

claim: Exact scale Ward identities make every physical mass gap homogeneous of degree one in chi when no independent dimensionful boundary datum is present.
evidence: Homogeneity theorem in v0.5 Section 3.3; scale-invariant QFT literature
limitation: Assumes spontaneous scale selection and a well-defined physical spectrum.
next_test: Test adiabatic co-scaling of dimensionless hadron ratios in a lattice or functional nonperturbative formulation.

claim: In the exact locked theory Lambda_nf/chi is constant, up to derivative corrections in an inhomogeneous chi background.
evidence: Local derivative expansion in v0.5 Section 3.4
limitation: Nonperturbative constructive proof for QCD plus chi has not been supplied.
next_test: Derive c_Box and c_partial from a concrete microscopic model or lattice response calculation.

claim: A heavy threshold obeys the exact RGI recursion delta_(n-1) = A_j delta_n + (1-A_j) epsilon_j.
evidence: Dimensional/RGI proof in v0.5 Section 4; Chetyrkin-Kniehl-Steinhauser arXiv:hep-ph/9708255
limitation: The response A_j must be evaluated using the chosen physical RGI conventions.
next_test: Evaluate A_j through the highest available perturbative order and quantify matching-scale uncertainty.

claim: A real scalar S and vectorlike Dirac fermion Psi~(3,1,0) form a conventional renormalisable controlled-breaking sector.
evidence: Lagrangian and counterterm discussion in v0.5 Section 5
limitation: The simple perfect-square alignment potential is a renormalised surface, not protected by the broken S->-S symmetry.
next_test: Run the full quartic/Yukawa RG system and test vacuum stability beyond the local Hessian.

claim: The chi-S ratio mode is locally stable for lambda_S>0 and nonzero r; the common radial direction is flat under exact global scale symmetry and becomes positive definite only in a gauged or lifted completion.
status: PASS for ratio mode; CONDITIONAL for radial completion
evidence: Analytic Hessian: one positive ratio eigenvalue and one exact radial zero mode; lifted determinant 2 lambda_S f^2 r^2 m_chi^2; 50,000-point lifted scan
limitation: A positive radial mass is incompatible with exact spontaneously broken global scale symmetry unless the mode is gauged away or scale symmetry is lifted; the global version contains a massless dilaton.
next_test: Choose explicitly between global, locally Weyl-gauged, or controlled-lifting completions and analyse the corresponding physical state space.

claim: The added controlled-breaking sector is Lorentzian-unitary and has a standard positive physical spectral interpretation.
evidence: Conventional two-derivative scalar and vectorlike gauge theory; no fourth-order elementary field
limitation: Does not constitute a constructive nonperturbative proof of the full theory.
next_test: Check optical-theorem positivity for representative mixed scalar-gluon amplitudes at one loop.

claim: One misaligned fundamental Dirac colour triplet above the top threshold transmits a leading QCD lock defect with coefficient 2/27.
evidence: Telescoping beta-function derivation and symbolic verification in v0.5 Section 6
limitation: Higher-order decoupling and matching corrections modify the coefficient.
next_test: Compute the NLO/NNLO value using modern decoupling constants and RGI masses.

claim: For a Dirac threshold in colour representation R, the leading transmission coefficient is 4 T(R)/27.
limitation: Requires asymptotic freedom and a threshold ordering compatible with the EFT.
next_test: Catalogue viable representations under asymptotic-freedom, collider, and relic constraints.

evidence: Clock sensitivity projection in v0.5 Section 7; atomic/molecular clock sensitivity literature
limitation: K_q, K_alpha, nuclear and hyperfine corrections perturb the simple factor two.
next_test: Build a full sensitivity matrix for Sr, Cs, CaF, Yb+, Al+, and Th-229 and fit the rank-one vector.

claim: For one unscreened long-range scalar and one dominant QCD spurion, beta_AB/eta_CD = -(Delta K_mu-Delta K_q)/Delta Q_mhat^CD.
evidence: Elimination of the common scalar source amplitude in v0.5 Section 8; Damour-Donoghue charges; scalar-clock literature
limitation: Fails with multiple scalars, screening, short range, significant electromagnetic/direct quark couplings, or inconsistent source conventions.
next_test: Re-derive in a full multi-charge basis and include finite-range Yukawa source profiles.

next_test: Replace semi-empirical charges with modern nuclear calculations and propagate uncertainties.
